  { url: 'https://corsproxy.io/?' + encodeURIComponent('https://www.masters.com/en_US/scores/feeds/scores.json'), parser: parseMasters },
];

// ── Parsers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function parseESPN(data) {
  const out = {};
  let maxRound = 1;

  try {
    const competitions = data.events?.[0]?.competitions || data.competitions || [];
    const comp = competitions[0];
    if (!comp) throw new Error('no comp');

    const competitors = comp.competitors || [];
    competitors.forEach(c => {
      const fullName = c.athlete?.displayName || c.athlete?.fullName || '';
      if (!fullName) return;

      const status = (c.status?.type?.name || '').toLowerCase(); // active, cut, wd, dnf
      const thru = c.status?.thru ?? null;
      const linescores = c.linescores || [];

      const rounds = [null, null, null, null];
      linescores.forEach((ls, idx) => {
        if (idx < 4) {
          const val = parseInt(ls.value);
          if (!isNaN(val) && val > 0) {
            rounds[idx] = val;
            if (idx + 1 > maxRound) maxRound = idx + 1;
          }
        }
      });

      const isMC  = status === 'cut' || c.status?.type?.shortDetail?.toLowerCase().includes('cut');
      const isWD  = status === 'wd'  || status === 'withdrawn' || status === 'mdf';
      const isDNF = status === 'dnf' || status === 'disqualified';

      out[fullName.toLowerCase()] = { name: fullName, rounds, isMC, isWD, isDNF, thru };
    });
  } catch(e) {
    console.warn('ESPN parse error', e);
  }
  currentRound = maxRound;
  return out;
}

function parseMasters(data) {
  const out = {};
  let maxRound = 1;
  try {
    const players = data.data?.player || [];
    players.forEach(p => {
      const name = (p.display_name || p.name || '').trim();
      if (!name) return;

      const rounds = [null, null, null, null];
      for (let r = 1; r <= 4; r++) {
        const rd = p['round' + r];
        if (rd?.strokes && parseInt(rd.strokes) > 0) {
          rounds[r-1] = parseInt(rd.strokes);
          if (r > maxRound) maxRound = r;
        }
      }

      const status = (p.status || '').toLowerCase();
      const isMC  = status === 'cut' || status === 'mc' || p.cut_made === false;
      const isWD  = status === 'wd'  || status === 'withdrawn' || status === 'mdf';
      const isDNF = status === 'dnf' || status === 'disqualified' || status === 'dq';
      const thru  = p.thru || p.hole || null;

      out[name.toLowerCase()] = { name, rounds, isMC, isWD, isDNF, thru };
    });
  } catch(e) { console.warn('Masters parse error', e); }
  currentRound = maxRound;
  return out;
}

// ── Fetch loop ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function fetchScores() {
  setStatus('loading');
  const feed = FEEDS[workingFeedIdx];
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(feed.url, { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + resp.status);
    const data = await resp.json();
    const parsed = feed.parser(data);
    const count = Object.keys(parsed).length;
    if (count === 0) throw new Error('empty');
    playerScores = parsed;
    document.getElementById('round-label').textContent = currentRound + ' of 4';
    setStatus('ok', count + ' players loaded');
  } catch(e) {
    console.warn('Feed', workingFeedIdx, 'failed:', e.message);
    // try next feed
    if (workingFeedIdx < FEEDS.length - 1) {
      workingFeedIdx++;
      return fetchScores();
    }
    setStatus('error');
  }
  updateTime();
  renderLeaderboard();
}

function setStatus(state, msg) {
  const bar = document.getElementById('status-bar');
  const dot = document.getElementById('dot');
  const footer = document.getElementById('footer-status');
  if (state === 'ok') {
    bar.className = 'status-bar'; bar.style.display = 'none';
    dot.className = 'dot live';
    footer.textContent = 'Live — refreshing every 90s';
  } else if (state === 'error') {
    bar.className = 'status-bar error visible';
    bar.textContent = 'Could not load live scores — will retry in 90s';
    dot.className = 'dot';
    footer.textContent = 'Score feed unavailable';
  } else {
    dot.className = 'dot live';
    footer.textContent = 'Refreshing...';
  }
}

// ── Name matching ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function lookup(raw) {
  const key = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (playerScores[key]) return playerScores[key];
  for (const k in playerScores) {
    if (k.includes(key) || key.includes(k)) return playerScores[k];
  }
  // last-name fallback
  const parts = key.split(' ');
  const last = parts[parts.length - 1];
  if (last.length > 3) {
    for (const k in playerScores) {
      if (k.endsWith(' ' + last)) return playerScores[k];
    }
  }
  return null;
}

// ── Score calculation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function calcTotal(golfers) {
  const rp = Math.max(1, currentRound);

  const scores = golfers.map(name => {
    const p = lookup(name);
    if (!p) return { strokes: null, name };

    let strokes = 0;
    let roundsDone = 0;

    for (let r = 0; r < rp; r++) {
      if (p.rounds[r] !== null) {
        strokes += p.rounds[r];
        roundsDone++;
      }
    }

    if (p.isMC || p.isWD || p.isDNF) {
      // penalty rounds for every round after they played
      const penaltyRounds = rp - roundsDone;
      strokes += penaltyRounds * MC_SCORE;
    } else if (roundsDone === 0) {
      return { strokes: null, name };
    }

    return { strokes, name, roundsDone };
  });

  const valid = scores.filter(s => s.strokes !== null);
  if (valid.length < 5) return { total: null, droppedName: null, scores };

  const sorted = [...valid].sort((a, b) => b.strokes - a.strokes);
  const droppedName = sorted[0].name;
  const best5 = valid.filter(s => s.name !== droppedName).slice(0, 5);
  const total = best5.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.strokes, 0);
  const par5 = PAR * rp * 5;

  return { total, droppedName, scores, par5 };
}

// ── Rendering ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function fmtDiff(strokes, parBase) {
  if (strokes === null) return { text: '--', cls: 'pending' };
  const d = strokes - parBase;
  return d < 0 ? { text: d.toString(), cls: 'under' }
       : d > 0 ? { text: '+' + d, cls: 'over' }
               : { text: 'E', cls: 'even' };
}

function renderLeaderboard() {
  const rp = Math.max(1, currentRound);

  const results = PARTICIPANTS.map(p => ({ ...p, calc: calcTotal(p.golfers) }));
  results.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.calc.total === null && b.calc.total === null) return 0;
    if (a.calc.total === null) return 1;
    if (b.calc.total === null) return -1;
    return a.calc.total - b.calc.total;
  });

  let html = '';
  let displayPos = 1;

  results.forEach((r, i) => {
    const calc = r.calc;
    if (i > 0 && calc.total !== null && calc.total === results[i-1].calc.total) {
      // tied — keep same displayPos
    } else {
      displayPos = i + 1;
    }

    const tieCount = results.filter(x => x.calc.total === calc.total && calc.total !== null).length;
    const posText = calc.total === null ? '--' : (tieCount > 1 ? 'T' : '') + displayPos;

    let posClass = 'regular', rowClass = '';
    if (calc.total !== null) {
      if (displayPos === 1) { posClass = '';        rowClass = 'first-place'; }
      else if (displayPos === 2) { posClass = 'silver'; rowClass = 'second-place'; }
      else if (displayPos === 3) { posClass = 'bronze'; rowClass = 'third-place'; }
    }

    // total
    let totalHtml;
    if (calc.total === null) {
      totalHtml = '<div class="score-num pending">--</div><div class="score-label">pending</div>';
    } else {
      const par5 = PAR * rp * 5;
      const f = fmtDiff(calc.total, par5);
      totalHtml = '<div class="score-num ' + f.cls + '">' + f.text + '</div><div class="score-label">(' + calc.total + ')</div>';
    }

    // golfer cells
    let cells = '';
    r.golfers.forEach((name, idx) => {
      const p = lookup(name);
      const isDropped = calc.droppedName === name;
      const cellCls = 'golfer-cell' + (isDropped ? ' dropped' : '');
      const shortName = name.split(' ').slice(-1)[0]; // last name only to fit

      let scoreHtml = '', holeHtml = '', badgeHtml = '';

      if (!p) {
        scoreHtml = '<div class="g-score pending">--</div>';
        holeHtml  = '<div class="g-hole">no data</div>';
      } else if (p.isWD) {
        scoreHtml = '<div class="g-score mc">WD</div>';
        holeHtml  = '<div class="g-hole">withdrew</div>';
        badgeHtml = '<span class="g-badge wd">WD</span>';
      } else if (p.isDNF) {
        scoreHtml = '<div class="g-score mc">DNF</div>';
        holeHtml  = '<div class="g-hole">DNF</div>';
        badgeHtml = '<span class="g-badge wd">DNF</span>';
      } else if (p.isMC) {
        scoreHtml = '<div class="g-score mc">MC</div>';
        holeHtml  = '<div class="g-hole">missed cut</div>';
        badgeHtml = '<span class="g-badge cut">MC</span>';
      } else {
        let strokes = 0, done = 0;
        for (let rr = 0; rr < rp; rr++) {
          if (p.rounds[rr] !== null) { strokes += p.rounds[rr]; done++; }
        }
        const f = fmtDiff(done > 0 ? strokes : null, PAR * done);
        scoreHtml = '<div class="g-score ' + f.cls + '">' + f.text + '</div>';

        const thru = p.thru;
        if (!thru || thru === '18' || thru === 'F' || String(thru) === '18') {
          holeHtml = '<div class="g-hole">F</div>';
        } else {
          holeHtml = '<div class="g-hole">Hole ' + thru + '</div>';
        }
      }

      if (isDropped) badgeHtml += '<span class="g-badge drop">dropped</span>';

      cells += '<div class="' + cellCls + '"><div class="g-tier">T' + (idx+1) + '</div>'
             + '<div class="g-name" title="' + name + '">' + shortName + '</div>'
             + scoreHtml + holeHtml + badgeHtml + '</div>';
    });

    html += '<div class="lb-participant">'
          + '<div class="lb-p-row ' + rowClass + '">'
          + '<div class="pos ' + posClass + '">' + posText + '</div>'
          + '<div><div class="p-name">' + r.name + '</div><div class="p-tb">TB: ' + r.tiebreaker + '</div></div>'
          + '<div class="score-cell">' + totalHtml + '</div>'
          + '</div>'
          + '<div class="golfer-grid">' + cells + '</div>'
          + '</div>';
  });

  document.getElementById('leaderboard').innerHTML = html;
}

function updateTime() {
  const now = new Date();
  const h = now.getHours() % 12 || 12;
  const m = now.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2,'0');
  const ap = now.getHours() >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
  document.getElementById('update-time').textContent = h + ':' + m + ' ' + ap + ' ET';
}

fetchScores();
setInterval(fetchScores, 90000);
</script>
</body>
</html>
